reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 8 points better, in a game of about 220 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Hornets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Grizzlies.
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 70 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 194 and 242 total points.
